nindian-history-133-7.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-133-7.x: The Doctrine of Lapse is Lord Dalhousie's. The Drain Theory is Dadabhai Naoroji's, the Two-Nation Theory is linked with Jinnah and the Muslim League, and Hindutva with V.D. Savarkar.

nindian-history-120-5.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Surendranath Banerjee – Servants of India Society
Gopal Krishna Gokhale – Servants of India Society
nindian-history-120-5.x: Gokhale founded the Servants of India Society. Naoroji gave the Drain Theory, Banerjee founded the Indian National Association and R.C. Dutt wrote an economic critique of colonialism.

n9d4a53d8af1.s: The Welby Commission, appointed in 1895, examined:
n9d4a53d8af1.x: The Welby Commission of 1895 dealt with Indian expenditure and was regarded as one of the gains of Moderate pressure.

nee7cda6936f.s: How was 16 October 1905, the day the partition of Bengal took effect, observed?
o: With the boycott resolution at Calcutta Town Hall
With the founding of the National Council of Education
As a day of mourning, with hartal, Ganga bath and Rakhi-bandhan
With the adoption of Swaraj by the Congress
nee7cda6936f.x: 16 October 1905 was observed as a day of mourning and hartal; people bathed in the Ganga and tied rakhis as a symbol of unity.

n256d122d8bb.s:
Arrange in chronological order:
A. Establishment of the National Council of Education
B. Partition of Bengal took effect
C. Boycott resolution at Calcutta Town Hall
D. Annulment of the partition of Bengal
n256d122d8bb.x: The dates are 7 August 1905 (C), 16 October 1905 (B), 15 August 1906 (A) and 12 December 1911 (D).

n7c469ab059f.s: Which event helped intensify anger against the partition of Bengal?
o: The formation of the Muslim League in 1909
n7c469ab059f.x: Japan’s victory over Russia in 1904–05 inspired Asian and Indian nationalist sentiment and fed anger against the partition (Sumit Sarkar's interpretation).

nindian-history-128-16.s: With reference to the Partition of Bengal, which pair is correctly matched?
nindian-history-128-16.x: The partition was announced in 1905 by Viceroy Lord Curzon; the major response was the Swadeshi Movement and nationalists saw it as 'Divide and Rule'.

nindian-history-119-20.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-119-20.x: Lajpat Rai led the Extremists in Punjab. Tilak led in Maharashtra, Pal in Bengal and V.O. Chidambaram Pillai in the Madras Presidency.

n8c602bc3f7a.s: Which Andhra work was inspired by Japan's victory over Russia in 1905?
n8c602bc3f7a.x: Japan's victory over Russia inspired Adipudi Somanatha Rao's Japan Charitra (and the play Japaniyam).

n4817c07ed10.s:
Arrange the following places of Bipin Chandra Pal’s 1907 Andhra tour in chronological order:
A. Machilipatnam
B. Kakinada
C. Vizianagaram
D. Rajahmundry
n4817c07ed10.x: Pal visited Vizianagaram on 16 April, Kakinada on 17 April, Rajahmundry from 19 April and Machilipatnam on 27 April 1907.

n1b0ed674a61.s: Which of the following region – leader pairs is correctly matched?
n1b0ed674a61.x: C.Y. Chintamani led in Vizag/Vizianagaram; Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao led in Vijayawada and Konda Venkatappaiah in Guntur.

n5f14982ffd7.s: After the Rajahmundry college Vandemataram incident, 138 students were:
o: debarred from examinations for one year
debarred from examinations for two years
n5f14982ffd7.x: A total of 138 students were debarred from examinations for two years after the incident.

n597fc789d18.s: Who co-edited Bande Mataram with Aurobindo Ghosh?
n597fc789d18.x: Bipin Chandra Pal is identified with Aurobindo Ghosh as a co-editor of Bande Mataram.

nindian-history-93-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-93-13.x: Quit India began in 1942. Non-Cooperation began in 1920, Civil Disobedience in 1930 and the Arya Samaj was founded in 1875.

nindian-history-93-14.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-93-14.x: The Faraizi Movement was led by Haji Shariatullah. Champaran was led by Gandhi, Swadeshi by the nationalists and the Neo-Buddhist Movement by B.R. Ambedkar.

n266091702d5.s: The Indian Press Act was enacted in:
n266091702d5.x: The Indian Press Act was enacted in 1910, following the Newspapers (Incitement to Offences) Act of 1908.

nac8820a89eb.s: A basic cause of the Surat Split of 1907 was:
o: the Extremists' lack of faith in the Moderates' capacity to negotiate with the British
the annulment of the partition of Bengal
the founding of the Home Rule Leagues
nac8820a89eb.x: The Extremists lacked faith in the Moderates' capacity to negotiate with the British (UPSC 2016). The partition was annulled in 1911 and the Home Rule Leagues came in 1916, after Surat.

nindian-history-115-15.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Second session of the Muslim League – Lucknow
First annual session of the Muslim League – Karachi
nindian-history-115-15.x: The League's first annual session was at Karachi. It was founded at Dhaka (1906), its second session was at Amritsar and the Lucknow Pact was signed at Lucknow.

nindian-history-115-16.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Tilak Home Rule League – Annie Besant
Besant Home Rule League – Nawab Salimullah
nindian-history-115-16.x: Nawab Salimullah is linked with the 1906 Muslim League. The Tilak league was led by Tilak, the Besant league by Annie Besant, and the Lucknow Pact by Jinnah and Tilak.

nindian-history-115-20.x: The Lahore Resolution of 1940 demanded separate independent states for Muslims, hence the name Pakistan Resolution.

nindian-history-120-27.s: Madam Bhikaji Cama is best known for:
o: Leading the Home Rule League in Madras
nindian-history-120-27.x: Bhikaji Cama worked for revolutionary nationalism abroad and unfurled an Indian flag at Stuttgart in 1907; Congress Radio was Usha Mehta's work.

n19303587d9b.s: Which Canadian Prime Minister apologised in the House of Commons in 2016 for the Komagata Maru episode?
n19303587d9b.x: Prime Minister Justin Trudeau apologised in the Canadian House of Commons in 2016 for the Komagata Maru episode.

n6b18027655e.x: Darsi Chenchayya, the only Telugu member of the Ghadar Party, wrote the autobiography Nenu Naa Desam.

nindian-history-109-3.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-109-3.x: Comrade was Muhammad Ali's paper. Sanjibani was Krishna Kumar Mitra's, Sandhya Brahma Bandhab Upadhyay's and Vande Mataram Pal and Aurobindo's.

nindian-history-8-1.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-8-1.x: The Leader is linked with Madan Mohan Malviya. The Bombay Chronicle was Pherozeshah Mehta's, Justice T.M. Nair's and Searchlight Sachidanand Sinha's.

nindian-history-120-11.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Ram Prasad Bismil – Chittagong Armoury Raid
Batukeshwar Dutt – Central Legislative Assembly bombing
nindian-history-120-11.x: Batukeshwar Dutt carried out the Central Assembly bombing with Bhagat Singh. Bismil led Kakori for the HRA, Surya Sen the Chittagong raid, and Savarkar founded Abhinav Bharat.

n302603b8d1e.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bharata Khandambu Chakkani Padi Aavu – Gurajada Apparao
n302603b8d1e.x: Veera gandham tecchinaramu was by Tripuraneni Ramaswamy. Bharata Khandambu was Chilakamarti's, Kallumanandoy Gollapudi Sitarama Sastri's and Desabhakti Geyam Gurajada's.

nap-history-5-19.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Andhra Pradesh Gandhiji – Nanduri Subba Rao
History of Indian National Congress – Dr. Pattabhi Sitaramayya
nap-history-5-19.x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya wrote History of the Indian National Congress. Vavilala Gopalakrishnayya is linked with Andhra Pradesh Gandhiji, Shyamala with Nallapoddu and Nanduri Subba Rao with Yenki songs.

nap-history-5-14.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: At the Feet of the Master – Gurajada Appa Rao
nap-history-5-14.x: Mahaprasthanam is by Srirangam Srinivasa Rao (Sri Sri). At the Feet of the Master is by Jiddu Krishnamurthy, Kanyasulkam by Gurajada and Neeti Chandrika by Chinnaya Suri.

na1afc55982f.s: Which is recognised as the first Telugu national song?
na1afc55982f.x: “Hinduvulara ennaallee gati” by Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham, the first Telugu national poet, is recognised as the first Telugu national song.

ne4f4e387ea1.s:
With reference to Virasam:
1. Sri Sri was its founding President.
2. It was formed at Hyderabad in July 1970.
3. It is the Progressive Writers' Association of Telugu.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
ne4f4e387ea1.x: Sri Sri was Virasam's founding President and it was formed at Hyderabad in July 1970. Virasam is the Viplava (Revolutionary) Writers' Association; the progressive body is Arasam (1943).
